Acceptance Criteria

You might say

Write clear acceptance criteria for the itinerary feature: saving shows the trip, refresh keeps it, and invalid dates explain how to fix them.

Acceptance criteria are checkable conditions that determine whether a result is acceptable.·For an itinerary, saving can show the trip, refresh can keep it, and an end date before the start date can explain how to correct it. This turns “mostly done” into observable results. Code coverage or framework choice alone cannot prove the user need is complete.
Know first
PRD
AC
How an itinerary request becomes checkable completion
trip.local/hangzhou-weekendDraft
ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST○Trip appears after save○Trip remains after refresh○Invalid dates explain the fix
Hangzhou · Weekend for two¥1,240
09:30West Lake40 min walk
14:00Zhejiang Art MuseumRain plan · indoors
!End date cannot be before start date

↳Every item on the left must have evidence in the real page on the right.

What evidence acceptance needs

State a result a person can see: “Show an itinerary card after save,” “keep it after refresh,” and “explain an invalid date” can all be checked in the page. “Good experience” and “works normally” cannot.

Align scope before building: Ask an AI Agent to implement against the conditions, then operate and record each result. The same completion basis works for features, fixes, and handoff.

What it is not

Acceptance criteria are not an implementation checklist or a coverage target. They focus on the delivered user result; unit tests, review, and performance checks still address other risks.
